leo_sales: FYI - AtlasMed (enterprise, HIPAA) asking for a 12mo commit. Estimate ~9M tokens/mo, peak ~700 concurrent short chat reqs (bursts ~15-25m). 95th target <=250ms. Asking for reserved GPUs + burst credits + preheat plan + BAA. Can eng/sre/pricing/sec/Legal advise? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-2468 :wave:

anya_eng: Quick clarifying q's - 700 concurrent = in-flight requests? avg prompt+resp tokens? any heavy long-form?

leo_sales: Yes in-flight. Avg combined prompt+reply ~400 tokens. Long-form generation rare (~3%). Embeddings are nightly batch (~5%). They're okay with 4-bit quantized models for prod but want a float fallback for critical cases.

dave_sre: Throughput ballpark: A100-equivalent ~120 RPS at ~400 tokens (quantized conservative). Baseline GPUs = ceil(700/120)=6. Add ~50% headroom for flash windows => +3 GPUs. Recommend 6 reserved + 3 burst pool = autoscale up to 9. Spread across 2 AZs; spot allowed for burst up to 25%. KV cache prefill required to meet tail SLOs.

anya_eng: Autoscale JSON suggestion to paste into Dedicated config:
{
  "min_replicas": 6,
  "max_replicas": 9,
  "scale_metric": "concurrent_requests",
  "target_per_replica": 120,
  "scale_up_cooldown_s": 45,
  "scale_down_cooldown_s": 240,
  "burst_pool_credits": 3
}

carmen_pricing: Need a quick ballpark for SOW (12mo reserved vs on-demand). Also call out compliance & BAA fees.

dave_sre: Quick cost sketch: reserved A100-equiv $7,000/GPU-mo -> 6 * $7k = $42k baseline. Burst credits priced ~35% of reserved when consumed; assume bursts used 10% month -> 3 * $7k * 0.35 * 0.1 ~= $735. Add compliance/support margin ~15% => rough monthly ~$50k. Finance to finalize.

mira_sec: HIPAA checklist: BAA, CMK for envelope keys, VPC peering/private endpoints, audit logs export (365d), quarterly pen-test. Private deployment or Dedicated+VPC peering can work. Need Legal to review BAA.

legal_bot: Noted. BAA review typically 3-5 biz days. We also need key rotation policy and explicit audit-log export path in SOW.

dave_sre: Ops runbook notes to hit 95th<=250ms:
- KV cache TTL=6h, prefill before peaks.
- Synthetic replay at 5-10% of expected peak 30-45m before flash windows.
- Canary 5-10% for 10m on deploys.
- Circuit-breaker: if 95th > 450ms for 2m, route new sessions to float-fallback model and notify SRE.

leo_sales: Action items: I'll put 6x reserved + 3x burst in draft SOW with cost ballpark and security notes. Carmen to draft formal quote, Mira to prepare security questionnaire answers and ping Legal for BAA. Dave to create OP preheat runbook. Schedule handoff with AtlasMed Tue 11am PT. Thanks all :handshake:
